notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
The game was updated 2 days ago, but I didn't have enough time to write down patch notes.

Bug fixes and Testing
Every known bugs are fixed.
Testing is also enhanced, I did a bot that plays the game 24/7 and if anything happens I will notice. 
Good news even after a couple days of gaming, there were no performance drop.

New features
Now you can see every buff enemies get in the left-top

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/b9823820b0ab9146b46409569b5b2fc8a2be7760.jpg

Auras of Bendrix and Cobra (on level 3) are now visible.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/ea9e638de6f6bfc586c43fdb4877146374596684.jpg

notes.title: The first update
notes.notes:
More than a week left from the Early Access launch. Thanks for positive curator reviews the game recieved. They motivated me a lot.

The patch affects almost every aspect of the game. Most importantly UI.

User Interface improvements

 Help section is improved
 Tutorials are improved
 Robot management is now more friendly
 Options menu now is more friendly
 Achievements section now shows rewards for each achievement
 Now Rewards screen shows rewards you get for achievements
 Now you can see achievements info from Pause menu
 Icons are updated
 Minor fixes and improvements


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/e7110fa8760854b28e33a455f8123d791529d3b0.jpg

Balance changes

 Fast start and 3 power upgrades are buffed.
 Spider tactics now gives 1 more damage
 Patient spider now gives 1 more damage
 Flying trainer now gives 15 damage against flyers
 Now Leaf at 3-level stuns the target for 1.2 seconds
 Dragonspawn-A1 has 345 HP now.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/98121a3d857fb1c9c8a1ed3e10dcf68c4b1f287f.jpg
Mechanics changes

 Procedural generated maps are more accurate now
 Chances of getting items in hard mode are increaced
 More rewards for infinity mode.(Depends on how long you survive)
 The game is optimized even more. Now it will not lag even after 200+ waves.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33637085/b388b990cfa7da70011563c423eb8b53037e7217.jpg
